dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, is the person in that painting... moving!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Umm, hi! Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}. You couldn't tell us what this place is, could you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope, nothing. She doesn't seem to be able to hear us at all...

choices.text: Maybe our greeting wasn't formal enough?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "O fair and noble lady, hearest thou our question?"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, yeah, all we needed to get a response was an elegant greeting... Pff, as if! Surely it's just a painting that can move?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, mysterious as it is, we're not gonna find the answer by just waiting around. Why don't we go search for clues someplace else?

choices.text: Why don't you take a look inside the painting, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh, so all Paimon needs to do is go inside the painting and we'll magically get to the bottom of this... Yeah right! Just how is Paimon supposed to do that!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #And why are we even talking about this like it's a possibility? What world are you living in, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Never mind... As mysterious as a moving painting is, we're not gonna find the answer by just waiting around. Why don't we go search for clues someplace else?

choices.text: I'm the Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius!
